newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: BTC resumes trading on Ljubljana bourse.
newsitem.headline: BTC resumes trading on Ljubljana bourse.

text.p: Trading in shares of shopping centre operator BTC, which was suspended on Tuesday, resumed at 0730 GMT, the Ljubljana bourse said.
The bourse suspended BTC on Tuesday half an hour ahead of the company's news conference regarding an issue of global depositary receipts (GDRs) in order to prevent possible insider information.
At the conference, BTC said it successfully completed the sale of GDRs last Thursday. The offer was six times oversubscribed.
Prior to the suspension BTC fell 3.29 percent to 14,120 tolars on volume of 158 shares on Tuesday.
After four minutes of trading on Wednesday, BTC shares were 90 tolars higher at 14,210.
